claims.statement: Audit necessary occupation conditions for the open marked-block Laplace bound.
claims.domain: As specified in each lane; do not silently transfer a surrogate result.
claims.first_missing_step: Prove a uniform discrete ballot estimate for the actual weighted weak-composition bridge: for all admissible R,K, L=floor(c log R), remainders 0<=r<2L, and z0 in (1,2), establish at least P(S_{2Lq}-beta(2Lq)<log2(eta/z0) for every 1<=q<=n)>=c1/n, with c1>0 independent of all parameters, or determine the correct order. The theorem must handle the random remainder, negative O(1) complete endpoint, strict/weak barrier atoms, and possible repeated block totals. Without this estimate the proposed L/R obstruction is only conditional.

supporting_evidence.statement: Audit necessary occupation conditions for the open marked-block Laplace bound.
supporting_evidence.domain: As specified in each lane; do not silently transfer a surrogate result.
assumptions: Actual reference model: Y_i are uniform nonnegative integer weak compositions of K into R coordinates. beta=log2(3)-1, K-beta R in (-15-2beta,-13-2beta). R=2J+epsilon. z_j=z0*2^(S_(2j)-2beta*j), z0 in (1,2).

Disjoint useful blocks have L=floor(c log R) pairs. C_q requires nonlow entry z>=eta, every pair total in {1,...,B0}, and nonresonance. Target E exp(-lambda N_C)<=C/R. Additional exact first-passage conditioning is a separate law issue.
